header: # PGS000783 (CC_Breast_IV) - breast-cancer polygenic score, 162 variants, GRCh37, inverse-variance weights (beta/SE). Source: PGS Catalog scoring file https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/spot/pgs/scores/PGS000783/ScoringFiles/PGS000783.txt.gz, downloaded 2026-11-26 (Last-Modified 2026-04-13; sha256 of the .gz 1a59eed44f4c38b032a40bca1418a657164a29a5ece9824f52319bdd12b585d0, of the text after this line c045c0c420cc4180818cb4c5fa865e4f04e0ba4f306f52bc5e6417cad723b6c6). Score publication: Kachuri L et al., Pan-cancer analysis demonstrates that integrating polygenic risk scores with modifiable risk factors improves risk prediction, Nat Commun 11, 6084 (2020), doi:10.1038/s41467-020-19600-4, licensed CC BY 3.0 IGO (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/igo/; the publisher's article page, read 2026-11-26; Crossref's metadata records CC BY 4.0, which the article page does not), (c) 2020 The Author(s), with credit to the World Health Organization as that licence's terms on the article ask, which implies no endorsement by it. The article weights each variant by beta/SE, its log odds ratio over that estimate's standard error in the BCAC meta-analysis (Michailidou K et al., Nature 551:92-94, 2017, doi:10.1038/nature24284; GWAS Catalog GCST004988), over the 162 of PGS000072's 187 variants that reached P < 5e-8 there. Cite the PGS Catalog as Lambert, Wingfield et al., Nat Genet 56:1989-1994 (2024), doi:10.1038/s41588-024-01937-x. Change: this line was added; every line after it is the Catalog's file, unchanged. See DATA_LICENSES.md.

Per-sample effect-allele dosages are redistributed elsewhere, in the slices DATA_LICENSES.md section 4 lists (30 individuals in the browser payload), with the 1000 Genomes consortium citation IGSR asks for; IGSR attaches no licence instrument to them.
